title: test(spec): the first root-level test file group's titles state each cited decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 28)
body:
Part of #20749
Clause-②: no

Stage 28 of this card: the next area of class (e), the test strings shipped under `packages/spec/src`, as ruled in `5902360492` on #20513. This stage takes the first name-ordered group of the test files directly in `packages/spec/src/`: 20 files, `assembled-package-body.test.ts` through `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts`. 18 of them carried 61 tracker ids in test titles. All 61 now either state what their record decided, in words (form D), or drop the number where the title already says it. No declared string or expect message in the group carries an id, so no needle is in play. Text only: no assertion, identifier, test count, code comment, file name or non-test file changes. The card stays open for the second group.

## Census (re-taken first)

The census instruments of stages 10-27 are not on disk in this container, so `census28.cjs` (md5 `31d8488b5194b8d3048e3fcaec0efaed`) was rebuilt from the definition those stage reports give: an AST walk over the `packages/spec/src` test files, one message per folded string (a lone literal, a template, or a plus chain) that matches the gate's id pattern, a title when the folded root is argument 0 of a describe / it / test / suite / bench call (each, skip, only chains included), comments never read. It was calibrated against two published readings before it was trusted: 128 messages / 130 ids in 37 files at stage 27's landing `f7b8a5932b`, and 191 / 200 in 53 files (titles 162 / 168, other 29 / 32) at `aa09db58c9`. Both reproduce exactly.

| reading | messages / ids | files |
|:--|--:|--:|
| the group, base `28bff18d0` | 61 / 61 (all titles) | 18 |
| class (e) whole, base `28bff18d0` | 134 / 137 (titles 122 / 125, other 12 / 12) | 42 |
| class (e) whole, this head | 73 / 76 (titles 61 / 64, other 12 / 12) | 24 |
| the group, this head | 0 / 0 | 0 |
| files directly in `src/`, base then head | 118 / 120 in 30 files, then 57 / 59 in 12 | |

The group reads 61, the claim's figure: no re-cut. The whole class reads 6 messages / 7 ids above stage 27's landing reading (128 / 130) because five new files outside this group landed since, all in subdirectories: `api/meta-item-response-shapes`, `automation/builtin-node-config` (2 / 3), `kernel/manifest`, `ui/action-description` and `ui/view-submit-redirect-url`.

Controls: lit, outside the group, at base and head: `ai/build-progress.test.ts` 2 / 2, `stack-artifact-crossref.test.ts` 11 / 12 and `stack-inline-action-crossref.test.ts` 13 / 13. Lit at base and dark at head, inside the group: the three stage-27 controls, `assembled-package-body.test.ts` 4 / 4, `compose-key-dispositions-export.pin.test.ts` 5 / 5 and `compose-stacks-action-collision-shape.test.ts` 3 / 3 (identical to stage 27's readings of them). Dark: five stage-27 files under `system/` read 0 while their comment lines still carry ids, and the 20 group files read 0 at head while 84 comment lines in them still carry ids (a wider pattern, any `#` plus digits, reads only the `(stack #0)` index positions of composeStacks refusal text, unchanged). Planted, in a scratch tree: ids in a describe title, a plus-chain title, an expect message, an it.each row name, a template title and a declared string each read once; a comment, a six-digit number, an HTML entity and a markdown heading read 0.

Per file, messages at base: assembled-package-body 4, compose-key-dispositions-export.pin 5, compose-stacks-action-collision-shape 3, compose-stacks-action-echo 4, compose-stacks-action-key-collision 2, compose-stacks-collection-pipe-arm 5, compose-stacks-concat-shape-refusal 1, compose-stacks-i18n-merge 2, compose-stacks-key-loss 8, compose-stacks-manifest-preserve 7, compose-stacks-merge-collection-refusal 1, compose-stacks-objects-shape-refusal 1, compose-stacks-refusal-envelopes 1, cron-typed-positions-retirement 5, define-stack-non-strict-actions-shape-refusal 3, define-stack-non-strict-objects-shape-refusal 1, eager-entry-import 1, inline-grid-column-carriers 7. `compose-stacks.test.ts` and `compose-stacks-merge-config-object-refusal.test.ts` carry ids only in comments.

## What changed

61 title literals, one line each, in 18 files: +61 / -61.
- 8 state the decision in words: the assembled body "declared apart from the authoring manifest" and "the mismatch that is the reason two declarations exist" (assembled-package-body 125 and 168), "defineStack's scope-qualified action-key refusal" in place of a rule number (compose-stacks-action-echo 176 and 224), "the 'merge' collection refusal, not an action-key collision" (compose-stacks-action-key-collision 222), "as read before the `pipe` arm took the authored side" (compose-stacks-collection-pipe-arm 211), "the inbound rate limiting config" (compose-stacks-key-loss 64), and "the export-job family, `ScheduleState`, the connector `DataSyncConfig`" (cron-typed-positions-retirement 347).
- 8 get their subject back where the number was the only subject: the five "compose-key dispositions export, pin N" describes and the three "composition rule N" describes.
- 45 drop a number the title already explains, with its connector: a `#N — ` prefix, a `[#N] ` prefix, or a trailing `(#N)`.

## Cited records

24 distinct ids. 23 answer 200 and were read with every comment the API serves. #14686 answers 404; its decision was read from its landing commit `279431e7a3` and that commit's changeset: `defineStack` refuses two actions that resolve to one scope-qualified runtime key. The comments counter of three records exceeds what the comments endpoint and the timeline serve (#5051 serves 2 of 5, #14848 7 of 8, #19150 5 of 6); everything served was read. What each record decided, as the titles now say it: #4910 the `server` key carries the inbound rate limiting config; #5005 the three composition rules (same value passes, a conflict throws a prescriptive error, an undeclared key warns); #5051 `i18n` joins them (option A, no last-wins); #14242 option B, the assembled body gets its own declaration (option C refused); #14512 a multi-package artifact carries its collections once in the package bodies, and keeps the flattened copy where the bodies cannot reproduce it; #14847 a bound standalone action appears once in the composed object; #14848 ruling 4, `objectConflict: 'merge'` refuses a differing collection; #14877 ruling 1, the compose-key table is a frozen public export; #15219 ruling A, `plugins` and `devPlugins` are envelope keys; #16075 option 1, the refusal extends to fixed-shape config objects; #16320 the seven cron-typed positions are deleted; #16348 composeStacks conflict refusals carry ADR-0112 envelopes; #17158 ruling A, the export-job family retires whole; #18239 ruling B, a non-array `objects` is refused with the envelope; #19150 a `pipe` is read on its authored side; #19784 ruling C, a non-array concat key is refused; #19785 and #19799 the non-strict `defineStack` door refuses a non-array `objects` and a malformed `actions` with the envelope; #19816 the collision pass skips a malformed `actions` and step 7 refuses it; #19930 every published entry imports first under `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1`; #20901, #20928 and #21142 each inline grid column carrier references `InlineGridColumnSchema`.

## Readers

184 needles (each old literal, a 24-character window around each id, and the text left and right of each id) were searched with `git grep -F` over the tracked tree at the base outside the 20 files, with a lit control (a known string, hit) and a dark control (a nonsense string, no hit). 7 needles hit, 24 lines: prose, changelog and code-comment lines elsewhere that share a short phrase, two `//` comment lines in `migrations/` that quote the old #20901 header, and one twin title. No gate, doc table, `-t` filter, snapshot, `currentTestName` read or self-test reads a rewritten title. The twin: `stack-artifact-packages.test.ts:355` carries the same old title as `compose-stacks-manifest-preserve.test.ts:308`. It belongs to the second name-order group; to keep the pair equal its rewrite should read `does not warn about an undeclared composition rule`.

## Text-only proof

- `textonly28.cjs` (md5 `957eff6b3837d762b8e03d070155930a`), per file, base text against head text: both texts with every string token masked are byte-equal (code and comments), the string-token counts are equal, and every changed token sits in a describe / it / test title position, carried an id at base and carries no `#` plus digits at head. 20 / 20 files SAME; 61 changed tokens, all titles, 0 declared; per-file counts exactly as predicted in writing at 2026-10-08T17:34:10Z, before the edit.
- 14 / 14 controls on scratch copies of the head files behave as predicted on the first run: an identifier rename, a numeric literal, a comment edit, a non-title string given an id, a rewritten title given a new id, a title that was id-free at base edited, one rewritten title reverted to base (SAME, 0 changed), an it.each row given an id, an expect message changed, a title re-split into a plus chain, a template title given an id, a test added, an id appended to a key-loss title, and an untouched file (SAME, 0 changed).
- `git diff -U0`: 61 plus and 61 minus lines, each the planned line; 0 added lines carry `#` plus digits; every file keeps its line count.

## Tests

- The 20 files with `--project local --project repo` and the JSON reporter, at the base (same worktree, before the edit) and at the head `437b4778f`: 594 / 594 passed in 20 files, 146 suites each side; per-file test count and status sequence identical in 20 / 20; 409 full names changed, 0 mismatches against the plan; 0 duplicate full names either side; names with `#` plus digits 409 at base, 0 at head.
- spec `vitest run --project local`: 626 files passed, 18720 tests passed | 1 todo, exit 0.
- spec `typecheck`: exit 0 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`); `check:test-typecheck` 52 files / 246 errors / 135 pinned signatures held, unchanged; `tsc --listFilesOnly -p tsconfig.test.json` holds 20 of 20 group files.
- turbo build of all packages: `Tasks: 71 successful, 71 total`. Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `dev-20749-s28`).
- No reverse verification or ablation applies: no assertion, gate or reader moved.

## Gates

All at `437b4778f`. The dispatch list (77 commands, derived at `fe98cc63a`) equals the list re-derived from the real change set at this head, 18 paths against merge base `28bff18d0`: nothing added, nothing dropped. All 77 exit 0 and `dispatch-gates --ran` reads "77 derived, 77 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Also run, exit 0: the five roster families that share a directory with the diff (`check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) and `check:generated` ("All 15 generated artifacts are up to date"). ESLint, narrowed and proven: 20 files linted with `--no-inline-config`, 0 errors, 0 warnings; the population read from ESLint's own config is 20 configured, 0 ignored; no file has `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is not enabled and this diff cannot move the verdict of a file it did not touch.

## Packaging and landing

- No changeset: `skip-changeset`. `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts` in `packages/spec` lists 2069 files, none of the 18 changed files and no `*.test.ts`; controls `src/stack.zod.ts`, `dist/index.mjs` and `package.json` are present; an old and a new title phrase read 0 files in `dist/`, the control `Unrecognized key` reads 42.
- Not governed: `check-governed-merges --test` on the 18 paths reads 0 of 18; 122 changed lines.
- `git merge-tree` onto `origin/main` `e36ee5351`: clean. None of the 19 open PRs touches any of the 20 files (file lists read; 7 of them touch `packages/spec/src`, so the reader sees them).

## Acceptance notes

- The next group is `root-entry-migrations-split.pin.test.ts` through `stack.test.ts`, 12 files, 57 messages / 59 ids at this head, with the one "other" string at `stack-cross-reference-envelope.test.ts` to be needle-checked there. The five new subdirectory files named above carry 6 messages / 7 ids; the cutting seat decides where they go.
- Code comments in these files still carry live ids (84 lines across the 20 files). Comments are not this card's share. Carrier: none.
- Same-id titles in other packages were not re-measured here; stage 27's list stands.
